Sales Coordinator - Swatch Group Sales Coordinator The company Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries 
• Job description We’re seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to join our team. As a Sales Coordinator, you’ll provide support to Brand Manager to ensure that all parts of the sales process run smoothly. Sales Coordinator supports Brand Manager by preparing reports to help achieve sales targets, managing administrative tasks, analysing sales data, generating reports and maintaining accurate client records. Key 
• Responsibilities and Duties BM/Sales Team Support: Tracking Sales data, monitoring order status, handling inquiries, and ensuring timely delivery. Reporting & Data Management: Sales data analysis, weekly/monthly reports, and maintaining accurate client records. Interdepartmental Coordination: Liaising with marketing, finance, and logistics to streamline sales operations. 
• Profile Experience: 2+ years in sales support / administration Strong organization skills and excellent customer service skills. Multitasking abilities with high attention to detail. Professional requirements Bachelor degree. Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Languages Excellent verbal and written communication skills for client interaction in Spanish and English Other languages as a plus Contact empleo@es.swatchgroup.com Job location C/ Yuca, 2 28109 ALCOBENDAS (Madrid Province) Spain Company address The Swatch Group (España) S.A. Edificio C, Miniparc I Calle Yuca, 2 Urbanización El Soto de la Moraleja ES-28109 Alcobendas, Madrid Apply for this job Share this job offer

Sales Coordinator - Swatch Group

Sales Coordinator
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
We’re seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to join our team. As a Sales Coordinator, you’ll provide support to Brand Manager to ensure that all parts of the sales process run smoothly.
Sales Coordinator supports Brand Manager by preparing reports to help achieve sales targets, managing administrative tasks, analysing sales data, generating reports and maintaining accurate client records.
Key 
• Responsibilities and Duties
BM/Sales Team Support: Tracking Sales data, monitoring order status, handling inquiries, and ensuring timely delivery.
Reporting & Data Management: Sales data analysis, weekly/monthly reports, and maintaining accurate client records.
Interdepartmental Coordination: Liaising with marketing, finance, and logistics to streamline sales operations.
Profile
Experience: 2+ years in sales support / administration
Strong organization skills and excellent customer service skills.
Multitasking abilities with high attention to detail.
Professional requirements
Bachelor degree.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Languages
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for client interaction in Spanish and English
Other languages as a plus
